items.quote: The EDS analysis was done at 15 kV using a working distance of 15 mm and by utilizing the ZAF-correction.

The cross-sections of the samples were prepared with the standard metallographic methods, and they were analyzed with a field emission scanning electron microscope (JEOL 6335F FE-SEM) equipped with an energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS, Oxford ISIS).

items.label: reaction couples
items.quote: The reaction couples were manufactured by placing a 100 lm thick near eutectic Au80/Sn20 (wt.%) [Au70.7/Sn29.3 (at.%), Goodfellow Ltd.] alloy foil between etched (1 min in dilute HCl + Methanol solution) 0.5 mm thick Cu foils (99,99+, Goodfellow Ltd.).
items.synthesis: The reaction couples were manufactured by placing a 100 lm thick near eutectic Au80/Sn20 (wt.%) [Au70.7/Sn29.3 (at.%), Goodfellow Ltd.] alloy foil between etched (1 min in dilute HCl + Methanol solution) 0.5 mm thick Cu foils (99,99+, Goodfellow Ltd.).

items.atmosphere_or_container: air furnace by utilizing RMA (Rosin Mildly Activated) flux
items.quote: The sandwich structures were subsequently soldered at 320 °C for 100 s and 2500 s at air furnace by utilizing RMA (Rosin Mildly Activated) flux and water quenching.

items.atmosphere_or_container: air furnace by utilizing RMA (Rosin Mildly Activated) flux
items.quote: The sandwich structures were subsequently soldered at 320 °C for 100 s and 2500 s at air furnace by utilizing RMA (Rosin Mildly Activated) flux and water quenching.
After the soldering for 100 s at 320 °C a number of samples were annealed at 150 °C in a forced convection oven (Heraeus Instruments UT6) for 6600 h.
